notes: IPO 1998-10-22 (NTT kept ~67%); world #3 at end-1999; tender offer by parent NTT completed Nov 2020, delisted 2020-12-25.

name: Industrial Bank of Japan
notes: World #1 in the MSCI 1989 list; merged into Mizuho Holdings (share transfer 2000-09-29).

name: Sumitomo Bank

notes: Treated as the continuing vessel of SMFG (kabutan 8316 price history is spliced from Sumitomo Bank). Legally Sakura Bank was the surviving bank in the April 2001 merger; human decision whether to show Sakura as the receiver.

name: Fuji Bank
notes: Merged into Mizuho Holdings 2000-09-29.

name: Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank
notes: Merged into Mizuho Holdings 2000-09-29.

name: Mitsubishi Bank
aka: Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi (1996); Mitsubishi Tokyo Financial Group (2001); Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (2005)
notes: Merged with Bank of Tokyo 1996-04-01 (Mitsubishi the survivor); MTFG holding company 2001; absorbed UFJ 2005-10-01. Treated as one continuing vessel (MUFG).

name: Sanwa Bank
notes: Became UFJ Holdings with Tokai Bank (2001-04-02); UFJ merged into MUFG 2005-10-01 (UFJ valued at about $38bn in the deal). Values 1990-1995 are estimates only.

name: Mizuho Financial Group
notes: Holding company formed 2000-09-29 by IBJ, Fuji Bank and Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank. Never a top-10 company itself; included for lineage.

name: Tokyo Electric Power
notes: Top 10 in 1989 (era c); in 1990 about $36bn, just outside our top 10 estimate. Collapsed after the Fukushima accident (March 2011): $32bn (end-2010) to $3.8bn (end-2011).

name: Exxon
notes: Absorbed Mobil 1999-11-30. Wikipedia names the current parent ExxonMobil Holdings Corporation (holding-company reorganisation; date not established in this research).

name: Mobil
notes: Merged into Exxon 1999-11-30 (deal valued at $77.2bn at announcement, Dec 1998). Never top 10 in 1990-1999.

name: Royal Dutch/Shell Group
aka: Royal Dutch Petroleum (NL, 60%) + Shell Transport & Trading (UK, 40%); Royal Dutch Shell plc (2005); Shell plc (2022)
notes: Values 1990-2001 are DERIVED from Royal Dutch Petroleum NY share price x shares / 0.6 (Royal Dutch held 60% of the group). One vessel for the dual-listed group; human decision needed if era c treats Royal Dutch and Shell T&T separately. CMC Shell data for 2005-2021 are far too low (about half) and are not used.

name: General Electric
notes: Spun off Synchrony (2015 exchange offer), GE HealthCare (2023-01-04) and GE Vernova (2024-04-02); remaining company renamed GE Aerospace.

name: Philip Morris Companies
notes: Spun off Kraft Foods (2007-03-30) and Philip Morris International (2008-03-28).

name: Wal-Mart Stores
notes: Listed on Nasdaq from Dec 2024.

name: American Telephone & Telegraph
notes: Spun off Lucent and NCR (1996), split off AT&T Wireless and Liberty Media (2001), AT&T Broadband to Comcast (2002); acquired by SBC 2005-11-18 for about $16bn.

name: Southwestern Bell Corporation
notes: Bought Pacific Telesis (1997), SNET (1998), Ameritech (1999), AT&T Corp (2005), BellSouth (2006), Time Warner (2018); spun WarnerMedia into Warner Bros. Discovery (2022). CMC slug att = this lineage.

name: Merck & Co.
notes: Absorbed Schering-Plough 2009.

name: Cisco Systems
notes: Networking hardware. 1990-1995 values are low-confidence (share count assumed constant back from 1996).

name: Lucent Technologies
notes: IPO April 1996 and spun off by AT&T Corp 1996-09-30; peak $259bn (1999-12-20); merged with Alcatel 2006-12-01.

name: Alcatel
notes: Lineage only: received Lucent 2006; acquired by Nokia 2016.

name: Nortel Networks
notes: Peak $252bn (2000-07-26, CMC daily); possibly briefly in the world top 10 in July-August 2000 (not on any quarter-end list we hold); bankrupt January 2009.

name: Nokia
notes: Handsets/network equipment.

notes: Merged with AirTouch 1999; took over Mannesmann 2000 (the largest takeover then, EUR 190bn). CMC values before 2000 look too low and are not used.

name: Mannesmann
notes: Acquired by Vodafone AirTouch (agreed 2000-02-04, EUR 190bn / about $183bn).

name: Deutsche Telekom
notes: IPO November 1996.

name: America Online
notes: Merged with Time Warner into AOL Time Warner (completed 2001-01-11).

name: Time Warner (1990)
notes: Merged into AOL Time Warner 2001-01-11.

name: AOL Time Warner
notes: New holding company (2001); renamed Time Warner 2003; spun off Time Warner Cable (2009-03) and AOL (2009-12); acquired by AT&T Inc. 2018-06-14 (about $85bn).

name: Citicorp
notes: Merged with Travelers Group 1998-10-08 (Citicorp valued at about $70bn).

name: Travelers Group
notes: Legally the surviving company (renamed Citigroup); shown here as merging into a new citigroup vessel - human decision.

name: Citigroup
notes: Formed 1998-10-08 from Citicorp and Travelers Group.

name: Pfizer
notes: Absorbed Warner-Lambert (2000), Pharmacia (2003), Wyeth (2009).

notes: CMC values for 2003-2006 appear about 15% above FT figures (FT lists exclude HSBC where CMC would rank it); treat with care.

name: American International Group
notes: Collapsed in 2008 (government rescue): $147bn end-2007 to $4bn end-2008.

notes: CMC values near big stock mergers (e.g. MBNA 2006) use post-merger share counts; 2005 value taken from CAO list.

notes: Top 10 in 2006-2008 (FT). Western investors largely shut out after 2022.

notes: H shares listed April 2000; A shares listed in Shanghai 2007-11-05, when the full share count at the A-share price gave about $1tn (Wikipedia peak $1.2tn nominal on that day).

name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China
notes: IPO 2006-10-27. CMC values for 2006-2019 are about 1.4-1.6x the FT values and are not used for ranking.

name: BHP Billiton

notes: #9 at end-1995 (CAO). CMC 2012 value is wrong and not used.

name: Google
notes: IPO 2004-08-19. Alphabet became the holding company on 2015-10-02 (treated as a rename). Values 2004-2013 computed from 10-K share counts (Class A + Class B) x year-end price; FT-based lists before 2015 excluded unlisted Class B shares.

name: Facebook
notes: IPO 2012-05-18; renamed Meta Platforms 2021-10-28. FT-based lists (to 2016) excluded unlisted Class B shares, so Facebook was missing from the Wikipedia Q4 2015/2016 lists although its full value ranked about #7-8.
